subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should reasoning presentation be owned independently by each channel plugin, or standardized as a shared user-configurable preference across channels?
rationale: Current architecture supports channel-owned rendering, while the requested option would create a new compatibility-sensitive config and plugin contract whose semantics cannot be chosen safely from source evidence alone.

options.title: Channel-owned rendering
options.body: Improve Telegram's native reasoning presentation locally without adding a global format option.

options.title: Shared semantic preference
options.body: Define capability-aware presentation choices with channel-over-agent precedence and documented fallbacks for unsupported channels.

options.title: Keep fixed presentation
options.body: Retain one project-selected style and limit changes to concrete rendering defects rather than adding user configuration.

recommendation.title: Channel-owned rendering
recommendation.body: Improve Telegram's native reasoning presentation locally without adding a global format option.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the shared reasoning/display paths and already analyzed the unresolved product gap.
